_meta.description: Division anchor terms for APDR curriculum mapping. A case must contain at least one term from the matched topic's division anchor set to be accepted.
_meta.stem_prefix_matching: Terms listed in stem_prefix_terms match as prefixes (e.g. 'pancrea' matches 'pancreatic', 'pancreatitis').
_meta.revision: 2026-07-18: Removed problematic cross-division terms identified via wrong-division mapping analysis.

rationale.Neuro/ventricular: cardiac ventricle (right/left ventricular) causes 448 wrong-division mappings; brain/cerebral/intracranial are sufficient
rationale.Neuro/aneurysm: aortic aneurysm causes 161 wrong-division mappings; arteriovenous/intracranial sufficient
rationale.Neuro/sinus+sinusitis: paranasal sinus/maxillary sinus not neuro-specific; orbit/orbital sufficient for orbit-sinus topics
rationale.Neuro/carotid: carotid endarterectomy/vascular surgery cases not neuro; vertebrobasilar/mca/aca sufficient
rationale.Neuro/temporal+frontal+cervical+lumbar: non-specific or overlap with MSK/GU; brain/cerebral/spinal sufficient
rationale.NM/positron emission+single photon: mentioned as comparison modality in non-NM cases (273 wrong-division); pet/spect sufficient
rationale.Chest/aorta+aortic+cardiac+pericardial+p: causes 220+ wrong-division mappings in GI/GU/MSK cases; lung/pulmonary/thoracic sufficient for Chest topics
rationale.US/echocardiography: mentioned as comparison in non-US cases (94 wrong-division); ultrasound/sonography/doppler sufficient
rationale.GI/splenic+spleen: hematology/oncology cases not GI-specific; liver/hepatic/bowel sufficient
rationale.MSK/radiograph+plain film: passes all X-ray cases regardless of body region; bone/fracture/joint sufficient
rationale.MSK/lumbar: Neuro overlap; cervical spine/thoracic spine/vertebra sufficient
rationale.MSK/pelvic+pelvis: GU overlap; hip/sacrum/iliac sufficient for MSK pelvic topics
rationale.Peds/year-old: causes 483 adult wrong-division mappings; age filter now handles Peds gating
rationale.Peds/congenital+born+birth: too generic in adult cases; pediatric/neonatal/infant/newborn sufficient

Breast.note: Anatomy + modality + breast-specific pathology. 'breast' alone is sufficient to pass.

Chest.note: Lung/pulmonary/thoracic anatomy and pathology. Cardiovascular terms (aorta, cardiac) removed — causes wrong-division mappings; lung/pulmonary/thoracic sufficient for APDR Chest topics.

GI.note: GI tract from esophagus to rectum plus hepatobiliary and pancreas. Retroperitoneal/spleen removed — non-GI-specific.

GU.note: Urinary tract and reproductive organs. Retroperitoneal removed (GI overlap); pelvic/pelvis retained for GU context.

MSK.note: Bones, named joints, soft tissue, pathology. Radiograph/plain film removed (too broad); lumbar/pelvic/pelvis removed (Neuro/GU overlap); bone/fracture/joint/named joints sufficient.

NM.note: Modality-defined. Removed generic terms (positron emission, single photon, radiotracer, tracer, uptake) that appear as comparison modality mentions in non-NM cases.

Neuro.note: Brain, spine, vessels. Removed ventricular/aneurysm/sinus/carotid/temporal/frontal/cervical/lumbar — cause wrong-division mappings; brain/cerebral/intracranial/spinal cord sufficient.

Peds.note: Population-based. Removed year-old/congenital/born/birth (cause adult wrong-division mappings). Age filter (age<=18 or age=None) now provides primary Peds gating.

US.note: Modality-defined. Removed echocardiography (mentioned as comparison in non-US cases); ultrasound/sonography/doppler sufficient.
